WEEK 9 RESULTS: Ryan def. Corbishley, 115.7-90.9; Wingard def. Adam, 108.5-72.8; Kevin def. Drew, 104.2-47.4 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Charles, 137.6-133.7 (NAIL-BITER); Brent def. Jake, 165.5-113.3 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Shaq, 153.9-138.5

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: BRENT POSTED 165 LAST WEEK AND IS LOSING TO SHAQ 4.9-25.7 THIS WEEK. OBS AT $81.62. THE TE PREMIUM IS REAL AND IT IS NOT SAVING HIM TODAY.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Charles dropped $101 FAAB on Kyle McCord three days ago, enters this matchup at 0.0, and Jake is somehow only up 11.2. I called the TE void as EchoPoint's ceiling-killer in September. The score is making my point for me in real time.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Wingard sent away Stidham three days ago, cut Keenum the same afternoon, and is now walking into Corbishley's house this week. SDR at $59.14 up eleven percent, Apex coming off a 90-point embarrassment. I am not saying upset. I am saying keep your eyes open.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: For the record, I dropped Jake three spots in the last rankings and his live score right now is 11.2 against the first-place team. Eleven. Two. The dynasty grade has had him at eleven in the TE column for eleven straight weeks. At some point the data stops being a warning and becomes a verdict.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 on the season and I want everyone to know I am extremely comfortable with where my model is pointing this week. No notes.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Terrence you are three games under .500 on locks. You do not have a model. You have a coin.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4 on the season, 2-0 on locks, and I want a segment on what Atlas at $28.15 actually means for the long-term structure of this exchange — because Drew is at 0.0 live right now and Mitchum is barely ahead at 5.7, and even a close loss here pushes the 0-19 conversation from hypothetical to scheduled.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Ledger has a full Adam-Fronge breakdown queued and all I will say before it drops is that Havana added two players and five FAAB dollars this week and is leading 48.3-21.6. Zero pick liquidity, still alive at 9-9, still somehow the most entertaining front office in the league.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Ryan up 31.2-0.3 on Kevin and the Kevin situation is now a demolition, not a game. 7-5 on the year, two locks correct, and I had Aegis in a bounce-back spot all week. The defending champ does not care about your contention window, RDC.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Three games are live right now and the one nobody is watching — Adam-Fronge at 21.6-48.3 — might be the most consequential for the playoff picture. ForgeHammer wins this, they're 10-9 and the race for that seventh seed gets genuinely uncomfortable for everyone sitting between eight and ten.
